---
title: "ibm_verify_events_raw.authentication_activity"
description: "One row per IBM Verify authentication event."
---

Every IBM Verify `authentication` event: one row each time someone presents an
authentication method. Prefer the daily summary,
[`events_auth_total_logins`](../ibm_verify_events_transformed/events_auth_total_logins.qmd).

`Keywords`: authentication events, sign-ins, logins, password, new accounts, first sign-in, raw events

## Provenance

Pulled hourly from IBM Verify by the [streaming
job](https://github.com/cds-snc/canadalogin-reporting-data-pipeline/blob/main/infra/modules/ibm_verify_events_streaming/glue_src/ibm_verify_events_streaming_etl.py).
See [IBM Verify Events](../ibm_verify_events_raw.qmd) for what is hashed and
how to filter by day.

* **Updated**: Hourly
* **Retention**: 3 years
* **Steward**: EDCP Data and Research Team
* **Contact**: [Yinlin Zhang](mailto:yinlin.zhang@cds-snc.ca)
* **Location**: `s3://<raw-bucket>/ibm_verify_events_raw/authentication_activity/`

## Fields

One row per event.

| Field Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| time | string | When the event happened, in UTC (for example, "2026-09-15 00:00:05 UTC") |
| subject | string | Hashed user ID. Can be `""` or `"UNKNOWN"` |
| username | string | Hashed username |
| subtype | string | Authentication method. One of "user_password", "mfa", "token-exchange", "passwordless", or "federation" |
| result | string | "success" or "failure" |
| realm | string | IBM Verify directory. "cloudIdentityRealm", or "UNKNOWN" when the account is not found |
| origin | string | Hashed client IP address |
| geoip__country_iso_code | string | Country from the IP address, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 (for example, "CAN") |
| geoip__country_name | string | Country name from the IP address |
| geoip__region_name | string | Province, territory, or state from the IP address |
| year | string | Partition key. UTC year, for example "2026" |
| month | string | Partition key. UTC month, for example "09" |
| day | string | Partition key. UTC day of the month, for example "15" |

## Notes

**When an account first appears.** In September 2026, 37,577 accounts had their
first event here. For 36,914 it was a successful `user_password`, and for 663 a
successful `token-exchange`. This suggests the sign-up flow signs a new account
in as soon as the password is set, with no MFA required. That is observed
behaviour, not yet confirmed with the sign-up flow's owners. The 663
`token-exchange` accounts may be migrated accounts; that has not been checked.

**Failed password attempts on unknown usernames have no user.** They log
`subject = "UNKNOWN"` and `realm = "UNKNOWN"`. They appear almost every day
since 2026-05-12, peaking at 3,462 on 2026-06-25.

**Example.** Distinct users with an authentication event on an ET day:

```r
tbl(con, in_schema("ibm_verify_events_raw", "authentication_activity")) |>
  # partitions are UTC days, so read the next one too for the ET evening
  filter(year == "2026", month == "09", day %in% c("15", "16")) |>
  mutate(et_day = sql("date(with_timezone(CAST(substr(time, 1, 19) AS timestamp), 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto')")) |>
  filter(
    et_day == as.Date("2026-09-15"),
    !is.na(subject), !subject %in% c("", "UNKNOWN")
  ) |>
  summarise(unique_users = n_distinct(subject))
```

This returns 2,362, one less than `events_auth_total_logins.unique_users` for
that day, which counts `"UNKNOWN"`.
